summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running: `main.py` imported from a nonexistent `greetings` module, so I changed it to import from `greeter`, and `greeter.py` was missing the colon on `def greet(name)`. After those edits the program ran cleanly and printed `Hello
